jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Tagged

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name":   {"type": "string"},
    "marker": {"type": "null"}
  },
  "required": ["name", "marker"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/taggedpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The "marker" property is wire-only: present and null on the wire,
// invisible to Go callers.
func TestTagged_NoMarkerField(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Tagged{})
	for i := 0; i < rt.NumField(); i++ {
		if strings.EqualFold(rt.Field(i).Name, "Marker") {
			t.Errorf("Tagged has a Marker field; null-only property should be wire-only")
		}
	}
}

func TestTagged_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"name":"alice","marker":null}`)
	var v Tagged
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if v.Name != "alice" {
		t.Errorf("Name = %q, want alice", v.Name)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{"name":"alice","marker":null}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, `{"name":"alice","marker":null}`)
	}
}

func TestTagged_MissingMarker(t *testing.T) {
	var v Tagged
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"alice"}`), &v)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want missing-required-field error")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), `"marker"`) {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want mention of marker", err)
	}
}

func TestTagged_NonNullMarker(t *testing.T) {
	var v Tagged
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"alice","marker":"oops"}`), &v)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want must-be-null error")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "must be null") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want must-be-null message", err)
	}
}
